# Build For Good

> Build For Good is a global, multidisciplinary community for turning meaningful problems into collective action — exceptional people across every field, building things that matter, together.

Build For Good (BFG) brings together genuine, ambitious, curious and compassionate people who want to become more capable without becoming less human. It is deliberately multidisciplinary — engineering, medicine, science, design, law, policy, philosophy and the trades meet on real work rather than in name. It is open to problems and selective with people: anyone can submit a problem through the Problem Commons, while membership is earned through an application, a conversation and a 30-day trial. Membership is judged by conduct, not credentials.

- Founders & stewards: founded and stewarded by Nikhil Nagpure; Build For Good belongs to its members, not to any one founder's company.
- Focus: turning meaningful problems into collective action through recurring rituals (Build Night, Deep Dive, Challenge, Think, Impact) and small project "Labs".
- Standard: twelve dimensions of character and capability, with character as a gate rather than an average.
- Motto: Build. Grow. Evolve. Together.
- Contact: hello@buildforgood.org

## Pages

- [Home](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/): What Build For Good is, who it is for, and how to get involved.
- [Manifesto](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/manifesto): Why Build For Good exists — capability without character is not enough, and the standard members hold each other to.
- [Values](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/values): Each value written as the behaviour the community rewards and the behaviour it corrects.
- [Membership](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/membership): The filter — twelve dimensions, a real conversation, and a 30-day trial. How to apply to join.
- [Problem Commons](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/problems): Submit a problem from anywhere, no membership required; problems are framed, parked or declined with a reason and can become Labs.
- [Projects](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/projects): A dynamic showcase of what the community is building across disciplines.
- [Activities](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/activities): The recurring rituals — Build Night, Deep Dive, Challenge, Think and Impact — and the quarterly rhythm.
- [Founders & Stewards](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/founders): The people who started and steward Build For Good.
- [About](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/about): What the name means, the multidisciplinary design, and the North Star: become more capable without becoming less human.
- [Contact](https://buildforgood.nikhilnagpure203.workers.dev/contact): Get in touch with the Build For Good team.
